name: Album of Miscellaneous Subjects, Leaf 4
material: album leaf, ink and color on silk
summary: The fourth painting by Fan Qi alludes to Wang Wei's poetic lines: In empty hills, there is no one there; Yet one can hear the sound of conversation.
